flashcard_questions.q: The element of the marketing mix concerned with how a product reaches the customer, including distribution channels and selling methods.
The route a product takes from the manufacturer to the final consumer, which may involve intermediaries such as wholesalers and retailers.
A distribution method where the manufacturer sells products straight to the consumer with no intermediary involved.

flashcard_questions.a: A business that sells goods directly to consumers through a physical shop or bricks-and-mortar premises.
A business that buys goods from manufacturers in very large quantities and sells them on to retailers, acting as an intermediary in the distribution channel.
